model.what: Our own prices for OLBG outright and race-winner markets.
model.inputs: Only the OLBG tip split and the disclosed field-size assumption below.
model.formula: p = (wins + a) / (total + k), Beta(a,b) prior with mean 1/N; decimal odds = (1 - 0.05) / p
model.caveat: Model output, not a bookmaker price and not a fact. Where the tip count is missing, no price is originated.
